name: EZ Pass Readers 2021
description: E-Z Pass readers are installed throughout NYC to determine traffic speed on local streets. The collected data was used to plan traffic calming and reorganizations of NYC streets. Projects like Midtown in Motion (MIM), a congestion management program served midtown Manhattan from 1st to 9th Avenue between 42nd to 57th Streets was conducted to make best adjustments for driver's needs. For a full list of annual EZ Pass Readers datasets please follow this link.
